description: This file defines the DeviceDetailFragment class for an Android application, specifically managing Wi-Fi Direct device interactions such as connecting, disconnecting, and transferring files with paired devices. It includes UI handling, connection management, and a nested AsyncTask for serving files over a socket.

classes.name: DeviceDetailFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that manages Wi-Fi Direct device connections, user interactions like connecting/disconnecting, and file transfers, including hosting a file server for incoming transfers.

classes.name: FileServerAsyncTask
classes.description: An AsyncTask that sets up a server socket to accept incoming file transfer connections, receiving files, and displaying received images.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Initializes the fragment's UI, sets up button click listeners for connect, disconnect, and send file actions.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result of the file chosen by the user and initiates file transfer via a background service.

methods.name: onConnectionInfoAvailable
methods.description: Handles Wi-Fi P2P connection details, starts server or client actions based on role.

methods.name: showDetails
methods.description: Displays selected device's details in the UI.

methods.name: resetViews
methods.description: Resets UI elements after disconnect or mode change.
